summary: Iteration 90: tested M-Box order announcements (Auftrags-Durchsagen) end to end. Backend: 18 of 19 pytest checks pass. Covered upload with 2-pass ffmpeg processing (normalised to -0.3 dB, 145.5 s), noise reduction (noise floor -29 dB -> afftdn applied, gain 35.1 dB, after -0.3 dB), delete removes the file from disk, rename, stream via ?token, delete permissions, manifest with label/order_pk, Pi download, group start with the same start_at (+6 s) delivered to the Pi, stop, 409 for a file still processing, 403 for another customer's order, customer list and auto-assignment by customer number. 1 FAIL: a customer without a customer number who gets access through the order override receives 403 on GET /api/mbox/devices. Frontend: customer flow on /durchsagen works fully (tile, upload, 'wird geprüft…' -> 'bereit · 0 dB', audio preview 200 audio/mpeg, rename, play toast 'startet in 6 s', stop-all button counts down, stop, delete). Admin order tile (real order 128): 'Masten laut Auftrag' is gone, customer access checkboxes plus toast 'Kundenzugang gespeichert' work, audio panel is present. Mast page Audio tab shows the label 'Evakuierung Halle 1'.

critical.issue: routes/mbox.py mbox_level() returns 'none' for role kunde unless customer_no is set. A customer who only has access via mbox_order_config.customer_user_ids can see the order in /my/orders and use /orders/{pk}/audio, but gets 403 'Kein Zugriff auf M-Box' for the devices list, the mast page, 'Masten ansehen' and single-mast control. Fix: return 'kunde' for every role=kunde (customer_device_ids already scopes the devices), or check customer_orders.

minor.issue: The JWT is passed as a query parameter (?token=) and therefore ends up in proxy/access logs. A short-lived signed stream token would be safer.

ui_bugs.issue: The delete button is always shown ((!kunde || true)). A customer can click delete on files uploaded by staff or other customers and only then gets a 403 error. Show it only for own files or for staff.
Before the first load finishes, order-audio-devices shows 'Aktuell kein Mast zugewiesen.' (misleading flicker). Show a loading state instead.
